summary: Independently verified both new My Wallet features (SAVE TO A GOAL + UNDO/FIX ENTRY) end-to-end. Extended /app/backend/tests/test_my_wallet.py from 11 to 23 pytest cases — all 23 PASS against the public URL. Playwright UI flow on /my-wallet (wallet_demo_child): (1) 'I used money' -> Save shows 'Where should it go?' with save-target-piggybank + save-target-goal-<goal_id> for every active goal (verified New Bicycle etc.). Selecting the New Bicycle goal and saving ₹7 dropped my_wallet 265->258 and lifted goal.current_amount 315->322; entry title reads 'Saved to New Bicycle 🚲', is_manual=true. (2) Editing that same entry to ₹12 through the pencil dialog (edit-entry-dialog / edit-amount-input / edit-submit-btn) adjusted by DIFFERENCE only: my_wallet 258->253 (net -5), goal 322->327 (net +5) — no double-apply. (3) Deleting via the trash icon (confirm dialog accepted) fully reversed: my_wallet 253->265, goal 327->315, entry vanishes from ledger. (4) Save to General Piggy Bank (no goal_id) increased savings jar 75->78 and inserted a 'Saved to Piggy Bank' entry; delete/undo works. Validation: overspend (>balance) and empty amount both keep the dialog open with error toast, no submit. Guard rows: gift_received (non-manual) exposes zero edit/delete buttons; every 'by me' entry exposes exactly one edit and one delete testid. Backend guards independently confirmed: DELETE/PUT on non-manual entry -> 400 'Only entries you added yourself can be…'; DELETE non-existent -> 404; save to unknown goal_id -> 404; PUT amount<=0 -> 400; PUT with new amount > wallet balance -> 400 AND the old spend is rolled back so nothing is lost.
critical_code_review_comments: wallet.py update_my_wallet_entry re-applies via _apply_entry_effect_raw but on a save-to-goal edit it does not re-check that the destination (goal) still exists after the reversal — if the goal was deleted between fetches the reapply silently no-ops on the goal branch. Low risk given UI flow, worth a guard.

add_my_wallet_entry + _reverse_entry_effect + _apply_entry_effect_raw perform 2-3 separate Mongo writes without a transactional session. A mid-call failure (e.g. during edit) could leave wallet debited but goal not credited. Consider wrapping these multi-write flows in a Motor session txn.
handleDelete uses window.confirm which is not styled/testable across mobile shells — consider a shadcn AlertDialog with data-testid='delete-confirm-btn' for a11y & consistency.

openEdit prefills editForm.note with entry.title, which for auto-defaulted rows is the friendly label ('Saved to Piggy Bank'), not the child's own note. On save this overwrites description with the label. Prefer keeping the raw stored description separate.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (save-to-goal, save-to-piggybank, edit-by-difference, undo, validation, non-manual guard)

test_credentials: child wallet_demo_child / testpass123 (has ~₹265 balance, goals: New Bicycle 315/2000, Video Game etc.).
seed_data_creation: Test suite creates TEST_ prefixed transient entries during a run and deletes them; net balance/goal state is restored per test. Prior iter's TEST_income/spend/save/give entries remain in ledger from earlier runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Save-to-goal + edit + delete are fully working and covered by 12 new pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_my_wallet.py (total 23). Seeded savings goals remain intact after each run — do NOT delete them. UI uses window.confirm() for delete — Playwright must register a page.once('dialog', accept) BEFORE clicking the trash. Save target picker only renders when dialog.bucket==='save'.
